evals.name: bisects a slow pipeline to its bottleneck
evals.prompt: My log crunching pipeline takes forever: cat access.log | grep 500 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20. Which part is slow and how do I speed it up?
evals.expected_output: Times the full pipeline, then growing prefixes to isolate the slow stage, and reports the bottleneck with before/after timings.
assertions: The response measures per-stage cost (timing prefixes or equivalent) rather than guessing which stage is slow.
The response names the bottleneck stage and gives a concrete fix for its class (CPU, I/O, or buffering).
The response quotes before/after timings from comparable runs.
